verdict.rationale: Pendo's analytics page says users can track and compare navigation paths to spot drop-off and improve conversion. Session Replay lets you click a funnel drop-off and watch the sessions behind it. No-code, retroactive, AI-tagged capture and Leo's natural-language questions support a founder getting answers without an analyst. Missing for 10: in-depth funnel documentation (step definition, conversion rates per step, segment breakdowns of drop-off), and independent or hands-on corroboration that founders self-serve these answers.
